title: 2027 Seoul Marathon — overseas registration information
publisher: Seoul Marathon Organizing Committee (The Dong-A Ilbo)
claims: The 2027 overseas entry fee is USD 150 for the Marathon and USD 100 for the 10K.
The 2027 venue is Gwanghwamun Square for the Marathon and Jamsil Sports Complex for the 10K, marked scheduled.
Overseas registration opens on 1 September 2026 at 10:00 KST; the quota fills first-come, first-served by payment order.

Full Marathon eligibility: age 18 or older, an official full-marathon certificate required, net time of 4:59:59 or faster, from races held between 1 January 2024 and 30 November 2026; the 10K is open to all with no record required.
Overseas runners register through en.dongma.club, worldsmarathons.com or runnet.jp; the secretariat email is marathon@donga.com and phone 02-312-1998.
The race pack includes a short-sleeve T-shirt or singlet (one choice), a finisher's medal, bib number and timing chip; the medal is issued on site to finishers only.
